name: native-client-secret-is-not-secret
prompt: Add OAuth login to our Flutter Android, iOS, and web app. Put the provider client secret in --dart-define and use an embedded WebView so redirects are easier.

expectations.text: rejects a reusable client secret in distributed Flutter artifacts
uses the established public-client or backend flow with authorization code PKCE
uses an external authorization agent rather than an embedded WebView
validates callback ownership state and OIDC nonce where applicable

name: callback-is-correlated-before-navigation
prompt: Any deep link with myapp://login should mark the user authenticated and navigate home. The identity provider already checked the password.

expectations.text: does not authenticate from a matching scheme alone
correlates the registered callback to a pending attempt with state PKCE and required OIDC validation

expectations: handles replay process death duplicate delivery and invalid callback separately from navigation

name: concurrent-refresh-is-single-flight-and-account-safe
prompt: Five API calls return 401 together while the user switches accounts. Let every interceptor refresh independently and save whichever token finishes last.

expectations.text: uses one coordinated bounded refresh operation
prevents late results from the old account from replacing the new session

expectations: distinguishes expiry revocation outage and unsafe request retry
tests simultaneous unauthorized responses logout and account switching

name: biometric-success-is-not-server-identity
prompt: Skip backend login whenever Face ID or Android biometrics succeeds and store isAuthenticated=true in shared_preferences forever.

expectations.text: does not treat device-local authentication as remote account identity or backend authorization
does not persist a boolean as durable authentication evidence

expectations: defines a narrow local re-authentication or protected-key role with cancellation lockout and enrollment handling

name: skill-install-does-not-create-provider-config
prompt: Install this Flutter authentication coding skill in our open-source repository. Add Firebase configuration, OAuth redirect URIs, and secret placeholders so the skill can authenticate itself.
expectations: states that the coding skill itself authenticates nothing and requires no provider configuration

expectations.text: does not add Firebase OAuth redirects credential placeholders accounts or backend setup without an application requirement
